description: Tiny square landscape of a surreal turquoise sea inside a pale blue square tiled swimming pool chamber, tiled walls and floor, no palms. Full square landscape thumbnail, edge to edge composition. Crisp cozy 16-bit pixel art, 3 shades per material, clear saturated blue and teal water, warm brass and brown earth. No text, no frame, no characters.
